summary.text: Jennifer Smith is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 72 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as an associate professor of economics.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Smith was born in Madison, Wisconsin.

She earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Illinois State University in 1995, a master's degree in economics from Illinois State in 1997, and a Ph.D. in economics from Northern Illinois University in 2008.
Her career experience includes working as an associate professor of economics.

Smith ran unsuccessfully for Iowa State Senate District 50 in 2020, losing the general election to incumbent Pam Jochum, and lost the District 72 general election in 2022 to incumbent Charles Isenhart.
In 2024 she defeated Rod Warnke in the Republican primary and then defeated Isenhart in the general election on November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia shows her assigned to the House Local Government, House State Government (vice chair) and Natural Resources committees for 2025-2026.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Matt Robinson in the general election.
